parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposures are limited: no criminalisation of trans expression, no documented border or facility restrictions, no police targeting (a national LGBT report recorded a year with zero reported police abuses, credited to a police human-rights department), and a prison protocol placing detainees by gender identity. A self-ID LGR regime, anti-discrimination law with gender-identity coverage, hate-crime aggravation, and migration/asylum protection on SOGI grounds are strong climate signals with functioning institutions that have litigated and enforced trans protections. Against this: two documented severe anti-trans violence incidents (a 2023 murder still unsentenced, a 2021 near-lethal beating), both isolated rather than patterned, plus a documented 2024 'year of regression' climate with an active ultra-right. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting is documented; the worst features are scattered incidents and an unsettled trajectory. This sits at reduced-to-low risk, slightly below the fully protected 0.85 anchors because remedies against violence are not shown operating and the climate is backsliding rather than stable.
